description: Self-hosted network monitor: watch what leaves, map where it goes, flag what does not belong
notes: Deputy Mode works now and needs no privileges.
Patrol Mode additionally needs Npcap, from https://npcap.com , which cannot be bundled because its licence forbids redistribution.
Seeing other devices also needs a vantage point: https://github.com/291-Group/LAN-Sheriff/blob/main/docs/VANTAGE-POINTS.md
